title: GDELT — поиск новостей и событий
summary: Поиск свежих новостей, происшествий и сообщений о событиях по городам, странам и темам. Источник — GDELT DOC 2.0 API. GDELT не предоставляет афишу, билеты или наличие мест. published_at — время регистрации/публикации статьи, а не дата события.

tool.name: search_news_gdelt
tool.description: Search recent news articles and media reports about a city, country, topic, or event using GDELT DOC 2.0. Returns article titles, publication timestamps, source information and links. Use this tool for city news, breaking news, cultural news, public events, incidents and recent developments. This tool does not provide verified event schedules, tickets or venue availability. Supply at least city or keywords. Use English keywords. Cite article links. published_at is the GDELT seen/publication timestamp, never the event date. Do not invent article summaries, schedules or missing facts. Report empty and error statuses honestly. For concert schedules prefer a specialized listings tool if connected.
